name: Manami Nayuka
source:
Obedient and devoted to the protagonist. She is deeply in love with him. She is energetic, but a screw-up.

She is pure-hearted and single-minded. Although she was separated from the main character when she was young, she cherishes the memories of the past when she was with him. Some years ago, a picture of him was sent to the countryside, and there were many evil spirits in it. When she learns of this, she decides to become a miko to exorcise them.

Favorite foods: Sanuki udon noodles, rice cooked in a pot, strawberry daifuku, oshiruko

Favorite movies: Movies with animals in them, Miyaz*ki films.

Favorite music: Enka and Enka idols

Special Skills: 3rd dan in calligraphy, 1st dan in aiki

Hobbies: Cooking (Japanese food only), basking in the sun

Things to do during days off: Cleaning and Laundry

Future goals: Become the main character's miko bride

People I respect: the head miko

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko.html]official site[/url]]
